map.输入患者体重或体表面积（BSA）并选择药物，按内置常用药物数据库计算单次与每日用: Enter patient weight or body surface area (BSA) and select a drug; compute single and daily doses by the built-in common-drug database, aiding clinical dosing (reference only).
map.按体重（mg/kg）计算单次与每日剂量，适用于儿科及按体重给药的成人用药。: Compute single and daily doses by weight (mg/kg), suitable for pediatrics and weight-based adult dosing.
map.按体表面积（BSA，Mosteller 公式）计算剂量，适用于抗肿瘤药等以 mg: Compute dosage by body surface area (BSA, Mosteller formula), suitable for drugs such as anti-tumor agents prescribed in mg/m2.
map.核对计算出的日剂量是否超过说明书最大日剂量，并对儿童用药信息不足的情况给出提示。: Cross-check whether the computed daily dose exceeds the label's maximum daily dose, and flag insufficient pediatric-dosing information.
map.：体重法：单次剂量 = 体重(kg) × 每公斤剂量(mg/kg)，日剂量 =: : weight method: single dose = weight(kg) * dose per kg (mg/kg), daily dose = single dose * times per day. BSA method: BSA(m2) = sqrt(height(cm) * weight(kg) / 3600) (Mosteller formula), single dose = BSA * dose per m2 (mg/m2), daily dose = single * times. When daily dose exceeds the drug's maxDay, an over-limit warning is given.
map.：60 kg、170 cm、30 岁，对乙酰氨基酚按体重法 10 mg/kg、每: : 60 kg, 170 cm, 30 years, acetaminophen by weight method 10 mg/kg, once daily: single = 60 * 10 = 600.0 mg, daily dose = 600.0 mg, below the drug's max daily dose 4000 mg. Same patient by BSA method (dose 10 mg/m2): BSA = sqrt(170 * 60 / 3600) = sqrt(2.8333) ~ 1.68 m2, single = 1.68 * 10 ~ 16.8 mg, daily dose 16.8 mg. The order-of-magnitude difference between the two methods shows: the dosing basis (mg/kg or mg/m2) must strictly follow the label, the two are not interchangeable - adult weight dosing of 10 mg/kg and BSA dosing of 10 mg/m2 differ by about 35 times.
map.什么时候该用体表面积而不是体重？: When should body surface area be used instead of weight?
map.细胞毒类抗肿瘤药、部分免疫抑制剂与儿科专用药多以 mg/m² 处方，因为体表面积: Cytotoxic anti-tumor drugs, some immunosuppressants and pediatric specialty drugs are mostly prescribed in mg/m2, because body surface area correlates more strongly than weight with basal metabolic rate, hepatic/renal function and drug clearance, reducing dose error in obese or cachectic patients. Common anti-infectives and antipyretic-analgesics are still dosed by mg/kg or fixed dose. The selection basis is always the dosing basis stated in the drug label.
map.Mosteller 公式的 3600 是怎么来的？: Where does the 3600 in the Mosteller formula come from?
map.Mosteller 公式 BSA(m²) = √(身高(cm) × 体重(kg): The Mosteller formula BSA(m2) = sqrt(height(cm) * weight(kg) / 3600) is a simplified fit to the Du Bois formula (BSA = 0.007184 * height^0.725 * weight^0.425), replacing power operations with a square root; within normal body types it usually differs from Du Bois by less than 1%-2%, convenient for bedside hand calculation. For extreme body types (severe obesity, severe wasting, large-area edema) use measured or more precise formulas.
